description: The linked reader's reading journal: the books they are reading now, with how each is tracked (pages, or time left for audio), where they got to, their totals, and whether today has an entry. With book, that book's recent days and notes instead. Suits "what am I reading", "where was I in X" and "what did I write about X this week". Needs a linked Siftivo account.

book.description: A title or workId, for that book's days. Omit for every book being read.

today.description: Today in the reader's own time zone, YYYY-MM-DD

name: get_my_journal
title: Get my reading journal
